name: named-host-before-network
source:
ip access-list standard MGMT
 10 deny 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
 20 permit host 192.0.2.7

name: named-sequence-inversion
source:

name: implicit-sequence-and-remark
source:
ip access-list standard X
 remark initial

 remark reserve

 permit any

name: numeric-nacl
source:
ip access-list standard 1300
 deny any
 permit host 192.0.2.7
!
end

access-list 99 permit 192.0.2.7
